newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes up on weaker ringgit.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes up on weaker ringgit.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price edged up five cents to 14.45 ringgit ($5.75) a kg on support from Japanese buyers following a weak ringgit against the dollar overnight, said traders.
"The currency factor prompted strong buying from especially Japanese buyers, and Europeans and locals," said a trader.
The ringgit reached a low of 2.5125 in European trading overnight but recovered to 2.5107 by 0200GMT on Tuesday.
Initial bids were 126 tonnes against offers of 102. Turnover was up 14 tonnes to 122 tonnes. The local premium over London widened to $45 from $25.-- K. Baranee (603-2307509) ($1=2.5110)
